title: "Publications"
title-block-banner: var(--bs-primary) url(images/recursos/bg_books.jpg)
format:
  html:

      - file: "_includes/parse_doi.html"
      - text: |
          <script async src="https://badge.dimensions.ai/badge.js" charset="utf-8"></script>

      text: |
          <script type='text/javascript' src='https://embed.altmetric.com/assets/embed.js'></script>
listing:
  - id: journal
    contents: 
      - publications/**/*.qmd
      - publications/publications.yml
    page-size: 30
    filter-ui: true
    fields: [year, author, title, container-title, doi]
    sort: "year desc"
    sort-ui: [title, author, container-title, year, doi]
    type: table
    image-height: 30px
    field-display-names: 
        title: "Title"
        author: "Authors"
        container-title: "Journal"
        funder: "Funder"
        year: "Year"
        doi: "Metrics"
    include: 
      type: "Article"
  - id: conferences
    contents: 
      - publications/**/*.qmd
      - publications/publications.yml
    page-size: 30
    filter-ui: true
    fields: [year, author, title, container-title, doi]
    sort: "year desc"
    sort-ui: [title, author, container-title, year, doi]
    type: table
    grid-item-align: left
    grid-columns: 3
    image-height: 30px
    field-display-names: 
        title: "Title"
        author: "Authors"
        container-title: "Conference"
        funder: "Funder"
        year: "Year"
        doi: "Metrics"
    include: 
      type: "Conference paper"
page-layout: full
